name: Boneburst Fleshwarp
disable: DC 30 Arcana check (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

items.name: Mangle
items.text:
Trigger A creature passes over or under the bridge, entering the area marked T

---
Effect Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes 3d10+14 piercing damage as bony protrusions pierce their flesh. Until the creature receives magical healing, the DC for skill checks to restore Hit Points to the creature increases by 2, and the creature reduces the number of Hit Points they recover per attempt by 5.

Critical Failure As failure, except the effect lasts 1 week.

text: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes bone spurs to rip through flesh.
